facts.activity_file: setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: unplanned release of chemical energy at PSV-7104

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on PSV-7104 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. PSV-7104 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during shift handover while the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 23 February 2015 a hazard report was recorded on PSV-7104 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during shift handover; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
